name: Postcard Flip
description: A postcard whose corner curls up under the pointer and is carried across until the card has turned over, showing the message side.

props.name: front
props.description: The picture side. It fills the card, which is 440px wide at the proportions of a postcard.

props.name: back
props.description: The message side. PostcardBack lays one out.

props.name: flipped
props.description: Controlled state: true shows the back. Changing it plays the turn.

props.name: onFlippedChange
props.description: Called when the card has been turned over.

props.name: turnLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the button that covers the card. Click it, press Enter or Space, or drag the card leftward past halfway to turn it; hovering or focusing lifts the lower right corner.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Give it an aria-label.

props.name: message
props.description: The note, written on the left half in pen blue.

props.name: address
props.description: Address lines, written on ruled lines on the right half.

props.name: postcode
props.description: Up to seven digits, written into red postcode boxes above the address.

props.name: stamp
props.description: The picture inside the perforated stamp, usually an img.

props.name: value
props.description: Face value printed on the stamp.

props.name: postmark
props.description: A round postmark with wavy cancellation lines, struck across the stamp.
